content: A person should be moderately wise, never too wise; an easy life has that one who knows not too much.
author: Celtic & Norse Proverbs
sourceWork: Meðalsnotr skyli manna hverr (Hávamál, Stanza 54) — Poetic Edda
explanation: Obsessive rumination and the endless pursuit of foresight can turn the mind into an echo chamber of dread. The High One counsels a sturdy balance: seek enough knowledge to act honorably and live well, but do not torment yourself by trying to foresee every misfortune that destiny has in store.
practicalInsight: Release the urge to over-analyze every possible future outcome today. Take right action in the present moment.
reflectionPrompt: Is your desire for certainty and total understanding robbing you of the simple joy of living?
